newsitem.title: USA: Bell & Howell raises tender price for debt.
newsitem.headline: Bell & Howell raises tender price for debt.

text.p: Bell & Howell Co said Thursday it has increased the tender price for all of its 11-1/2 percent Series B Senior Discount Debentures due in 2005, after determining that its initial offer was too low to clear the market.

It raised the price for the tender and the related consent solicitation to 110.5 percent from 110 percent of accreted value of the debentures up to, but not including, the payment date, the company said.

"We went out with an intitial price and in discussion with the bond holders, we felt this (new) price would be a price that would clear the market," Kevin O'Shea, vice president and treasurer of the company, said.
The company commenced the tender offer and concurrent consent solicitation on August 8.
Bell & Howell shares were down 15/16 at 27-5/16 Thursday.
